4/5 Rewards. Both tasks are rewarded the same way: by verified work, compared with every other miner. Accurate work earns more. Work that does not hold up under checking earns nothing.

5/5 What comes next. Fine-tuning competitions. The network will compete to train retrieval and ranking models, and any model that beats the current one on quality, speed and cost becomes part of Desearch search.
